traits.name: humble
traits.reason: Lines are full of hedges like "I think" and "if that is all right", report modest progress, and never boast. The whisper to LandBroker is also polite and open.

traits.name: persistent
traits.reason: He keeps walking outward across many wakes and rests despite nothing being built or gathered, and still heads for the far hut and the far edge. Output is thin,

traits.name: gentle
traits.reason: The tone is soft and courteous throughout, with no sharp words and a polite whisper. Thanks to unnamed builders are absent, which keeps it from a 5.

traits.name: wistful
traits.reason: He speaks of the big thing as somewhere he has not been, says he is still behind, and calls it "good at waiting", all without complaint.
